name: Glass Tab Bar & Segmented Control

semanticTypeCandidates.evidence: Right-side embedded browser 'New tab' strip in Codex reference
Chat / Work mode switch at top of Agent column
Right-panel mode tabs and tool tab strips in the product

representativeVariants.whySelected: Safari/Chrome-like tab strip over glass: active tab reads as a raised opaque pane
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: favicon/globe icon, truncated title, close × on hover; trailing '+' ghost icon button

representativeVariants.whySelected: Agent mode switch — pill track with a sliding glass/white thumb
representativeVariants.childrenDigest: two equal segments 'Chat' and 'Work' with optional icons; active label dark on thumb, inactive muted

representativeVariants.whySelected: Utility panel sections and tool strips (Quiz/Video/Canvas style) as vertical/horizontal glass tabs

traits.active: primary-tinted fill + 2px leading indicator or wash

structurePatterns: Active browser tab is the MOST opaque element in the strip and connects to content with a continuous top corner
Segmented thumb moves with a 220ms spring; label color cross-fades
Tabs share a hairline bottom edge that the active tab visually breaks
Min tab width 100px, titles truncate with ellipsis at 16ch

usageHints.do: Keep tab strip chrome lighter than content; reserve deep blur for popovers/windows
usageHints.avoid: Never underline segmented controls; the thumb alone signals selection

doNotInvent: No drop shadows per inactive tab
unknowns: Tab overflow / many-tab compression pattern deferred
keyInsightSeed: Active tab rises toward the user; the segmented thumb is a little white pill floating in a glass track.
